house.description: Length of time to elapse before a new education mandate takes effect required.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Education Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; requiring a length of time to elapse before a new education mandate takes effect; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 127A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[127A.02] ORDERLY TIME FRAME FOR K-12 EDUCATION CHANGES. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Local impact notes.+]

[+An enactment significantly affecting the duties of school districts and charter schools where a local impact note has been requested from the Legislative Budget Office under section 3.987 is not effective until that local impact note has been completed and posted to the Legislative Budget Office's website. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Education funding program implementation.+]

[+Notwithstanding section 645.02, any substantive change to a kindergarten through grade 12 education funding program that impacts the majority of school districts and charter schools enacted after March 1 of any calendar year is effective July 1 of the following calendar year. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2027. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; requiring a length of time to elapse before a new education mandate takes effect; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 127A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[127A.02] ORDERLY TIME FRAME FOR K-12 EDUCATION CHANGES.

Subdivision 1.

Local impact notes.

An enactment significantly affecting the duties of school districts and charter schools where a local impact note has been requested from the Legislative Budget Office under section 3.987 is not effective until that local impact note has been completed and posted to the Legislative Budget Office's website.

Subd. 2.

Education funding program implementation.

Notwithstanding section 645.02, any substantive change to a kindergarten through grade 12 education funding program that impacts the majority of school districts and charter schools enacted after March 1 of any calendar year is effective July 1 of the following calendar year.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2027.
additions: [127A.02] ORDERLY TIME FRAME FOR K-12 EDUCATION CHANGES.

An enactment significantly affecting the duties of school districts and charter schools where a local impact note has been requested from the Legislative Budget Office under section 3.987 is not effective until that local impact note has been completed and posted to the Legislative Budget Office's website.

Notwithstanding section 645.02, any substantive change to a kindergarten through grade 12 education funding program that impacts the majority of school districts and charter schools enacted after March 1 of any calendar year is effective July 1 of the following calendar year.
